prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Rohrsiedlung" (Pipe Settlement), a slum village built from gigantic stacked concrete and rusty steel pipes and old shipping containers, seen from above. A large open yard of cracked, patched concrete and packed dirt with puddles fills the middle of the image - this is the large walkable area, wet and reflecting cyan and pink light, uncluttered.
TOP LEFT: an old round riveted water tower on thick steel legs, its round tank painted all over with colourful children's crayon drawings (suns, rockets, a big cat - shapes only, no letters), a small door with a hatch and a rope ladder at its base facing the yard - the most eye-catching spot; on top of the tank a flat round roof platform with a railing, a patched tarp and a leaking corner with a bucket.
TOP CENTER: a tall wall of giant pipes stacked like a pyramid, their round openings closed with colourful curtains (red, yellow, teal) and warm yellow light inside, small wooden ladders and two rope-and-plank hanging bridges spanning between the pipes high up (drawn thin so they don't hide the floor).
RIGHT SIDE: a soup kitchen built from two welded containers with a big open service window, a huge steaming iron cauldron visible inside, warm orange light, a hand-painted bowl symbol on a sign (a symbol, no letters), a door next to it; in front of it on the yard two long wooden benches with tables.
BOTTOM LEFT: the entrance of a small metro station set into a huge half-buried pipe arch: stairs going down, glowing cyan railing, a round metro emblem (no letters).
BOTTOM RIGHT on the yard: a round open shaft in the ground with a heavy iron grate and a short ladder going down into the sewer, faint green glow and steam rising.
LEFT EDGE middle: a narrow passage under laundry lines full of hanging work overalls and bedsheets.
Edges: smaller pipes, barrels, crates, potted plants in tin cans, chalk drawings on the ground at the edges, cables strung between pipes drawn thin.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north), right of center - a ramp path between pipe stacks climbing up toward lanterns of a scrap market; LEFT edge (west) - the laundry-line passage leading out; BOTTOM LEFT - the metro stairs.
Time: night, after rain.
